name: Fun Pop
tagline: Neelshah's Fun preset: warm cream, orange, violet and green, rounded Jost type, playful springs and stickers.

motion.direction: Neelshah `Fun`. 118 BPM: enter 0.55 s / stagger 0.06 / exit 0.28 with back / elastic eases; Jost 700 display at 160 px, radius 28, stickers (`stamp`) and `chips` in orange `ter`, violet `gold`, green `goldd`; `ring` highlights; `counter`s that bounce once. Cream `stage`, panel `mar`. One accent per element, three across the frame; something pops every 2–3 s; captions on a rounded box with the spoken word orange. Playful, never sarcastic; no hard shadows.
